column1: # Core vocabulary checked by hand (Claude): one meaning per row, the usual word in each language.
# The review step (build/review.py) puts these words first in the matching meaning of each word, adds them if missing,
# so the cards show the everyday translation. "-" = no single word / leave as it is. Lemmas as stored in the dictionary.
# Base varieties: German (Germany, Swiss words come from the regional step), US English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spain Spanish.
